original_test_intent: Run a 12-hour 4-KiB random mixed-read/write fio reliability workload on every explicitly approved storage target and evaluate health plus IOPS against a comparable reference.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Run time_based fio with runtime=43200, bs=4K, rw=randrw, numjobs=32, size=4g and iodepth=32 on all drives.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: System remains workable, logs contain no error, and IOPS is at least 80% of the approved theoretical/reference value.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Only checked fio version and did not execute the workload.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Required explicit destructive targets and profile/reference inputs.
historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED; added per-clone size semantics, drive schedule and evidence-disk exclusion.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: One authorized engineer approves every stable target, data-loss boundary, profile, reference and recovery; execution can then be automated.
required_user_inputs: Signed stable target/range allowlist and exclusions

master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Targets, missing fio semantics, concurrency, performance reference and safety limits.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A safer approved project override may execute, but any duration/load/drive reduction is reported and does not satisfy the full Master profile.

original_method: Retain the raw fio profile but never instantiate filenames/devices until the exact stable targets and write ranges are approved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a reviewed fio jobfile with one traceable section per stable allowlisted target and JSON output on a separate protected evidence device.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pinned project-approved fio version; validate defaults and clone semantics locally.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: fio HOWTO for time_based, runtime, numjobs, size and iodepth semantics.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Adds explicit target/range, cache/ioengine/mix, scheduling and evidence boundaries without changing source defaults silently.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Profile changes remain approved overrides with measured coverage gaps.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Write-capable workload can destroy OS/user/evidence data and consume endurance.

safety_boundaries: Never write OS, mounted/in-use, user-data, evidence or unidentified devices.
Approval does not replace stable-ID/mount/topology verification.
No unapproved unmount, format, erase, auto-repair or rerun.
expected_evidence: Signed target/exclusion matrix and pre/post health
no_automatic_retry: Any media, filesystem, controller, target or fio failure is preserved; no automatic rerun or destructive recovery.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent validates target gates and records Actual/coverage; engineer decides performance and data-integrity outcome.
review_improvement: V3.1 removes V3's unnecessary two-person target requirement: one authorized engineer may approve, but exact device identity and all storage protections remain mandatory. This is governance simplification, not a safety relaxation.
